segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I wanted to walk through the revised quote for the calibration tracking package: 42 technician seats, 6 manager seats, and the two-day onboarding block. It comes to $31,860 for the first year if we start May 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. I have the sheet open. The seat count is right, but I need to understand the invoice timing. Finance asked if this all hits in May or if services can be separated.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can separate it. Subscription invoice on May 1 for $27,360, then onboarding services at $4,500 after the first session, likely the week of May 13. That keeps it cleaner for your cost center, I think.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That helps. The other thing is the term. Your order form says auto-renewal at twelve months with 60 days notice. Our legal team usually asks for 30 days.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I saw that note. I can ask deal desk to switch the notice period to 30 days and keep the same pricing. Honestly, I should have had that back to you yesterday, but my day got eaten by clerical stuff: typing updates into the CRM, cleaning up duplicate account records, matching contacts to the right division, and assembling the internal approval packet. It was like six hours of database and paperwork instead of actually talking with buyers, including you, so apologies for the lag.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No worries. As long as we can get the redline by Friday, we're okay. Our implementation window is tight because the audit prep starts June 10.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Friday is fine. For go-live, if we have signature by April 26, we can do kickoff May 6, admin training May 14, and technician training May 21. That gives you about two weeks before the audit prep.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Do we need all 48 seats active on day one? We may only have 35 techs using it in May.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: You can activate in phases. The contract would still cover 48 seats, but we can provision 35 at launch and add the remaining 13 when your second shift starts. No extra charge for that.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, send the 30-day notice version and the split invoice language. If legal doesn't push back, I'll route it for signature Monday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the updated order form and a one-page rollout timeline by end of day, and I'll include the subscription and services invoice dates in the email.
